name: Print Queue
author: Jon
description: Is it printing? A printer shows up in your bar while something's printing, turns red when it needs paper, and disappears when it's done.

barWidget.description: Hidden normally. Shows a printer with the job count while CUPS has unfinished jobs; red when a job is stuck or the printer needs you. Hover for each job, click to manage the queue.

schema.label: Check interval
schema.description: Seconds between checks while the queue is empty (every 2 seconds while there are jobs)
